read_aria_ply: read an ARIA global point cloud CSV, filter by distance std, and write a temporary PLY file
load_aria_frames: load ARIA scene frames from transforms JSON, filter by camera type, and subsample with stride
readAriaSceneInfo: read an ARIA scene config to build a SceneInfo object with train, validation, and novel view camera splits
refactor_read_aria_ply: refactor read_aria_ply to use projectaria_tools instead of the custom mps_point_cloud_reader re-implementation
review_readAriaSceneInfo: review readAriaSceneInfo to understand how seen vs novel view camera splits are determined by device ID
